parameters.name: Addr
parameters.description: The list of addresses in the address pool.

sub_parameters.name: Mode
sub_parameters.description:
The mode of the address. Valid values:

- **SMART**: smart return

- **ONLINE**: always online

- **OFFLINE**: always offline

parameters.name: EvaluationCount
parameters.description: The number of consecutive failed health checks.

parameters.name: Interval
parameters.description: The health check interval. Unit: seconds. The value must be 60.

parameters.name: IspCityNode
parameters.description: The list of city nodes for monitoring.

sub_parameters.name: CityCode
sub_parameters.description: The city code of the monitoring node. For information about valid values, see the response of DescribeGtmMonitorAvailableConfig.

sub_parameters.name: IspCode
sub_parameters.description:
- For information about valid values, see the response of DescribeGtmMonitorAvailableConfig.

- If GroupType is set to Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) or Overseas, IspCityNode.N.IspCode is optional. The default value is 465.

- If GroupType is not set to BGP or Overseas, IspCityNode.N.IspCode is required and must be used with IspCityNode.N.CityCode.

parameters.name: MinAvailableAddrNum
parameters.description: The minimum number of available addresses.

parameters.name: MonitorExtendInfo
parameters.description:
The extended information. The parameters that you must configure vary based on the health check protocol.

HTTP and HTTPS:

- port: The health check port.

- failureRate: The failure rate.

- code: The return code. A response with a return code greater than the specified value is considered abnormal. Valid values: 400 and 500.

- host: The host setting.

- path: The URL path.

PING:

- packetNum: The number of ping packets.

- packetLossRate: The packet loss rate.

- failureRate: The failure rate.

TCP:

- port: The health check port.

- failureRate: The failure rate.

parameters.name: MonitorStatus
parameters.description:
The status of the health check. Valid values:

- **OPEN**: enabled

- **CLOSE** (default): disabled

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the address pool.

parameters.name: ProtocolType
parameters.description:
The health check protocol. Valid values:

- HTTP

- HTTPS

- Ping

- TCP

parameters.name: Timeout
parameters.description: The timeout period. Unit: milliseconds. Valid values: 2000, 3000, 5000, and 10000.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of the address pool. Valid values:

- **IP**: IPv4 address

- **DOMAIN**: domain name
